The kernel accesses B as B_ptr + offs_k * stride_bk + offs_n * stride_bn. With p_c_attn_weight shape [N=2304, K=768], stride_bk should be weight.stride(1)=1 and stride_bn should be weight.stride(0)=768. The call passes these values but the kernel_function body appears to have a duplicate/overwriting call with wrong strides. Once this stride bug is fixed, enabling allow_tf32=True in gemm_qkv_kernel's tl.dot will switch from scalar FP32 FFMA (causing 8-way shared memory bank conflicts, 68% excess wavefronts) to Tensor Core MMA instructions, eliminating the bank conflicts and reducing register pressure from 248 to ~128 regs/thread, doubling occupancy from 12.5% to ~25%.
